relationships.subject: PRG-1
relationships.evidence_quote: PRG-1 overexpression has a role in alleviating pain, including thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia, and depression-like behavior

relationships.subject: P2X7 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X7 receptor KD also showed an analgesic effect in BCP rats, but not a depression-like behavior

relationships.subject: P2X7 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that P2X7 receptor play a role in BCP through PRG-1 and P2X7 receptor is the upstream signal of PRG-1 in BCP

relationships.subject: FTY720
relationships.evidence_quote: which serves as an activator of PP2A 76 and PRG-1/PP2A signaling 35

relationships.subject: A438079
relationships.evidence_quote: selective inhibition of P2X7 receptor by antagonist A438079 (D39-43, 1 μg once per day) 78 also significantly increased TWL and MWT values without cumulative effect

relationships.subject: bone cancer pain
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression levels of PRG-1 and P2X7 receptor in the hippocampus were both increased on postoperative day 45 in the BCP rats by immunofluorescence and western blot

key_findings: Hippocampal PRG-1 and P2X7R are increased in bone cancer pain rats; PRG-1 is analgesic/antidepressant while P2X7R is algogenic
P2X7R acts upstream of PRG-1/PP2A to regulate spine density
